incidents.name: Cone Vault malicious implementation adminMint
incidents.notes: Concentric's deployer wallet was social-engineered and the attacker used its proxy-admin rights to point the Cone Vault proxies at implementation 0xf36c407f3c467e9364ac1b2486aa199751ba177d, which added a backdoor adminMint() that burns LP from the staking contract and mints vault shares to the caller plus withdrawFromAdmin() to pull any balance still approved to the vault.

sources.ref: onchain review: attack tx calls Cone Vault V1 WETH/USDC proxy 0x8883d82e852f966ce88a9a9917d70d6f9e3933d9 with selector 0xc1f26123 (adminMint) from EOA 0x105f52fcc329cef4cbe25bc946f8a3738414e4a1; the proxy was created 2023-11-03 by 0xeaf6e2a3d22a9775a1cc692b207b7d8dd6a4944c, not by the attacker. It is an EIP-173-style proxy that emits no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, so the malicious upgrade is invisible to the mechanical measurement and the age is measured from deployment - flagged nonStandardUpgradeArchitecture. Tier-1 measurement: the hardhat-deploy EIP-173 proxy does emit its own ProxyImplementationUpdated(address,address) event (topic 0x5570d70a002632a7b0b3c9304cc89efb62d8da9eca0dbd7752c83b7379068296); eth_getLogs over [creation 146573591, incident 172948936] returns exactly two - 0x0 -> 0x8b85b292be63e4c3592ecf09b5500575037018e0 at deployment (block 146573591, 2023-11-03T02:47:32Z) and 0x8b85b292... -> 0xf36c407f3c467e9364ac1b2486aa199751ba177d at block 172948684 (2024-01-22T07:55:43Z, tx 0x6266b5d3ff0a8d366ac9d9470a3215e8ab0ac3dc4992b2d5381e059254b04737), i.e. the attacker's backdoor implementation was installed 64 seconds before the drain, so the exploited code was 64 seconds old rather than 80 days.

incidents.documentedLastChange: 2024-01-22T07:55:43Z (block 172948684, tx 0x6266b5d3ff0a8d366ac9d9470a3215e8ab0ac3dc4992b2d5381e059254b04737): the malicious upgrade itself - ProxyImplementationUpdated(address,address) (topic 0x5570d70a002632a7b0b3c9304cc89efb62d8da9eca0dbd7752c83b7379068296) emitted by the vault proxy 0x8883d82e852f966ce88a9a9917d70d6f9e3933d9, moving the implementation from 0x8b85b292be63e4c3592ecf09b5500575037018e0 to the backdoored 0xf36c407f3c467e9364ac1b2486aa199751ba177d, 64 seconds before the adminMint() drain
